description: What the SPA served by the local Python server is allowed to ask the shell for. The `default` capability deliberately leaves IPC inert on that origin, so each entry here is opened deliberately and kept minimal. start_dragging / internal_toggle_maximize: with an Overlay titlebar the webview covers the whole title area, so macOS offers no draggable strip of its own and the page must nominate one with data-tauri-drag-region — which Tauri implements over IPC. opener:allow-open-url: opens a link in the user's own browser, so the 'Star on GitHub' link does not navigate the app itself out of the library. check_updates_now: lets the Check for updates button reach the updater. The whole surface is moving the window and opening a URL.
